summary: Luís I (1838–1889) was king of Portugal from 1861, when he succeeded his brother Pedro V, until his death in 1889. He is in the atlas because his is the reign the atlas opens in: the record for the Portuguese state begins in 1886, three years before the crown passed to his son Carlos I.
